text:
erin: Heads-up - GCPChannelY submitted their June marketplace statement (GCP-762). Their export applied a partner promo code that should only apply to subscription SKUs, but it was incorrectly applied to metered usage. Net effect: their invoice understates our revenue by ~ $32,400. Can partner finance confirm and tell us next steps?

paul: I pulled our reconciled meter. Their billed units match our meter, but discount_pct=40% on metered rows for the entire month (should be 0%). Snapshot: reported_total=510,000 units, discount_applied=40%, billed_amount=$46,800 vs expected $79,200.

rina: Oof. Partner says they rolled out a pricing experiment across all SKUs in their export on 2026-06-01 and forgot to filter out metered SKUs. They acknowledge error and propose either (A) reissue corrected invoice for the delta, or (B) we post an accrual and collect AR once corrected. They prefer A.

erin: For month close we need a decision. If CM/credit does not include a debit, we should record an accrual for the missing revenue. Accounting preference?

paul: GAAP note: if revenue is earned and measurable, we should recognize it. Partner error is not our control, so accrual seems appropriate. Recommend posting AR accrual JV with GL 1-210 "Marketplace Accrued Revenue" and memo "Accrual pending corrected invoice from GCPChannelY GCP-762". Amount $32,400.

rina: Agreed. Also tag as "reseller_pricing_error" and create ticket to reverse/collect when corrected invoice received.

partner-finance: We'll ask GCPChannelY to issue a corrected invoice with the delta or a debit memo. They estimate 5 business days ETA.

erin: Create JV and a collection task. Also add note to month-close pack and set revenue hold flags to include this accrual so it's visible to FP&A.

billing-bot: Accrual JV created: JV-2026-0705, amount $32,400, GL 1-210, status: ACCRUED_PENDING_PARTNER, ticket FIN-4712.

paul: I'll attach the reconciliation snippet and the partner confirmation to FIN-4712. Also opening an infra ticket to add a validation rule: partner promo exports must include SKU type column and block applying subscription promo to metered SKU types. INFRA-7833 created.

erin: Thanks. Draft partner message (for records):

"Subject: GCP-762 - incorrect promo applied to metered usage"

"Hi <GCPChannelY billing contact>,

Thanks for the explanation. We've posted an accrued revenue entry (JV-2026-0705) for the understated June metered revenue pending your corrected invoice or debit memo. Please send the corrected invoice referencing GCP-762 to billing@redwood.ai so we can reverse the accrual and reconcile.

Best,
Erin (Finance)"

partner-finance: We'll follow up with them and request a formal RCA including the experiment flag and export IDs.

erin: Leave thread open until FIN-4712 is updated with corrected invoice or reversal.
